parent_objective: audit M2394 reset-only adapter result and choose bounded next route
blocked_by: M2394 validates reset compatibility but does not run rollout or measured execution
repair execution, training, ranking, and current-sim verdict remain blocked
supersedes: direct measured execution without result audit
interpreting reset validation as driver performance or paper evidence

public_gates: M2395 must audit M2394 summary and reset artifacts without rerunning reset validation
M2395 must classify what M2394 proves and what remains blocked
M2395 must choose a bounded next route or stop the branch
M2395 must not run rollout, execute repair, train, rank, select a winner, or make paper/self-ID/current-sim claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits reset-only validation result and decides whether measured validation design is now justified
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rollout, repair execution, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2394 summary is missing or inconsistent
stop if forbidden execution or claim flags are present
stop if audit routes directly to training, ranking, or paper conclusions
stop if reset validation is misinterpreted as measured performance
fallback_plan: route to bounded measured-validation design if reset pass is accepted
route to adapter repair design if reset artifacts are incomplete
stop for user review if no bounded non-ranking route is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2394 reset adapter result is available for audit

allowed_updates: M2395 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2394 pass is accepted or rejected with failure taxonomy
a bounded next route is selected or branch stops

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2395 audits reset validation and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2395; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Reset-validation result audit remains task-quality infrastructure and cannot be interpreted as driver capability or self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: can accept or reject reset-only validation evidence before measured validation design
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can establish task-quality reset readiness but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2395 proposes another non-executable artifact step before measured validation design
M2395 repeats reset-validation audit without new route
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A bounded audit can accept or reject M2394 reset-only adapter pass and route to measured-validation design without rerunning validation, executing repair, ranking, or making paper/self-ID/current-sim claims.
success_criteria: M2394 summary counts and forbidden flags are audited
M2394 pass is accepted or rejected with failure taxonomy
a bounded next route is selected or the branch is stopped
no reset rerun rollout repair training ranking or paper/self-ID/current-sim claim occurs
failure_criteria: M2395 reruns reset validation, rollout, measured execution, replay, PPO, or private holdout
M2395 executes repair levers or trains
M2395 ranks support policies or controller families
M2395 overwrites the active scenario config
M2395 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict or level3 self-ID claims
M2395 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write bounded M2394 effective candidate reset-validation result audit

decision_rule: M2395 passes if it audits M2394 and selects a bounded next route without reset rerun, rollout, ranking, training, or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claims.
